_comment_mysql: Either drop this file next to a repack that holds Settings/database.json, or point mysqlArgs at your own client file. Never put a password in this file: keep it in the MySQL client file, outside the repository.
_comment_paths: Only needed when several servers run on the same machine, or when the folders are not the repack's own.
_comment_dates: uptimeSince counts the server hours from that date; countFrom makes every figure start there instead of at the bots' creation.
_comment_publish: Optional: a folder a web server serves. The dashboard only writes index.html and stats.json there, so nothing on this machine is reachable from outside.
